name: bld_idempotent_sum_rank
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : (A + B) * (A + B) = A + B) : Matrix.rank (A + B) = Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank B
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : (A + B) * (A + B) = A + B), Matrix.rank (A + B) = Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank B
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_lin_idempotent_trace_eq_rank_field three times: rank(A+B) = tr(A+B) = tr A + tr B = rank A + rank B in K, then Nat.cast injectivity in characteristic zero.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K), A * A = A → B * B = B → (A + B) * (A + B) = A + B → (A + B).rank = A.rank + B.rank
